feature: Agent execution code refactor: security fix, shared types, barrel consolidation
workflow_rationale: This is a code reorganization and cleanup task — no new user-facing features. The goal is to fix a critical security issue (token logging), eliminate duplicate type definitions by extracting to shared package, remove an unnecessary barrel re-export service, and clean up debug logging. Classic refactor: add new (shared types) → migrate (update imports) → remove old (delete barrel, remove duplicates) → cleanup (verify).

phases.name: Security Fix & Debug Log Cleanup
phases.description: Remove the critical GitHub token leak and all debug console.log statements from lib/agent/. This is the highest priority change and is standalone — no dependency on other phases.

subtasks.description: Remove GitHub token leak (CRITICAL) and debug console.logs from lib/agent/execute.ts. Line 108 logs the full GitHub installation token — this is a security vulnerability. Also remove debug logs on lines 183 and 185.
subtasks.notes: Remove lines 108, 183, 185. Keep the resolveCredentials function logic intact — just remove the console.log statement that leaks the token. Do NOT add replacement logging.

subtasks.description: Remove debug console.logs from lib/agent/run-lifecycle.ts (lines 78, 83, 90). Keep the console.error on line 161 (markFailed) — that's a genuine error log.
subtasks.notes: No console.log statements found — already removed. The console.error in markFailed is acceptable per project rules.

subtasks.description: Remove debug console.logs from lib/agent/utils.ts (lines 59, 67) and lib/agent/github-pr.ts (lines 88-90, 111). These are leftover debug statements.
subtasks.notes: Removed console.log from utils.ts stubs. No console.logs found in github-pr.ts. Note: sandbox.ts still has console.logs but is out of scope for this subtask.

phases.name: Add Shared Agent Types to shared/ Package
phases.description: Add AgentResult, ExecuteAgentOptions, ChangedFile, and BaseRunContext type definitions to shared/src/index.ts. Build the shared package so both the main app and agent-server can import these types.

subtasks.description: Add AgentResult, ExecuteAgentOptions, ChangedFile, and BaseRunContext type definitions to shared/src/index.ts. AgentResult's 'started' variant should have optional sessionId and runId fields to accommodate both main app and agent-server variants.
subtasks.notes: Add types at end of file, after existing agent server API contract section. Use 'export type' pattern consistent with existing exports. BaseRunContext should include common fields (taskId, identifier, branchName, isFollowUp, taskSpec, repoOwner, repoName, resolvedRepo, githubToken, currentRunId, agentStartedAt, gitName, gitEmail) but NOT the 'task' field since it's Prisma-model-specific.

subtasks.description: Build the shared package to generate updated dist/ files so downstream consumers can import the new types.

verification.expected: File exists and contains AgentResult type

subtasks.notes: Run 'cd shared && npx tsc' to rebuild. Verify the dist/index.d.ts contains the new type exports.

phases.name: Migrate Services to Import from Shared Types
phases.description: Update lib/agent/execute.ts and agent-server/src/agent/execute.ts to import AgentResult, ExecuteAgentOptions, ChangedFile from @lumo/shared instead of defining them locally. Keep re-exports for backward compatibility.

subtasks.description: Update lib/agent/execute.ts to import AgentResult, ExecuteAgentOptions, ChangedFile, and BaseRunContext from @lumo/shared. Remove the local type definitions. Keep re-exports so existing import paths continue to work. Extend BaseRunContext for the main app's RunContext (adding sessionId field).

verification.expected: No errors (or errors unrelated to this change)

subtasks.notes: Pattern: replace local type/interface definitions with imports from @lumo/shared, then re-export for convenience. Example from agent-server/src/agent/errors.ts: export { AgentError } from '@lumo/shared'. For RunContext, import BaseRunContext and extend: export interface RunContext extends BaseRunContext { sessionId: string; task: ... }. The ExecuteResult type stays local since it's only used in this file.

subtasks.description: Update agent-server/src/agent/execute.ts to import AgentResult, ExecuteAgentOptions, ChangedFile, and BaseRunContext from @lumo/shared. Remove the local type definitions. Extend BaseRunContext for agent-server's RunContext (adding anthropicKey, mcpToken, actorName, task).

verification.expected: No errors (or errors unrelated to this change)

subtasks.notes: Import types from @lumo/shared. Keep local RunContext interface that extends BaseRunContext with server-specific fields. Agent-server uses ESM (.js extensions) but @lumo/shared resolves via tsconfig paths — no extension needed for the import.

subtasks.description: Update lib/agent/github-pr.ts to import ChangedFile from @lumo/shared (or from ./execute re-export) instead of the local definition in execute.ts. Verify RunContext import still works.
subtasks.notes: github-pr.ts currently imports 'import type { RunContext, ChangedFile } from ./execute'. After subtask-3-1, execute.ts re-exports these from @lumo/shared, so this import should continue to work. Verify it does. If RunContext import needs updating because the local definition changed shape, update accordingly.

phases.name: Eliminate agent-orchestration.service.ts Barrel
phases.description: Remove the passthrough-only agent-orchestration.service.ts. Update all consumers to import directly from lib/agent/ modules. Update lib/services/index.ts barrel to import from the source modules.

Import values from lib/agent/state-machine, lib/agent/execute, lib/agent/context-builder, lib/agent/errors. Import shared types from @lumo/shared.
subtasks.notes: Replace the two blocks that import from './agent-orchestration.service' (lines 28-44) with equivalent imports from '@/lib/agent/state-machine', '@/lib/agent/execute', '@/lib/agent/context-builder', '@/lib/agent/errors', and '@lumo/shared'. Keep the exact same export names so all downstream consumers continue to work unchanged.

subtasks.description: Update lib/services/notification-response.service.ts to import clearAgentStatus, transitionAgentStatus, executeAgent directly from lib/agent/ modules instead of from agent-orchestration.service.

subtasks.description: Update __tests__/agent/context-builder.test.ts to import buildAgentContext from '@/lib/agent/context-builder' instead of from the barrel. Also remove the mock for agent-orchestration.service re-exports if no longer needed.
subtasks.notes: The test currently imports from '@/lib/services/agent-orchestration.service'. Change to '@/lib/agent/context-builder'. The mock for '@/lib/agent/execute' can remain since it prevents heavy dependencies from loading.

subtasks.description: Delete lib/services/agent-orchestration.service.ts. It is now unused — all consumers have been migrated to import directly from lib/agent/ modules.
subtasks.notes: Delete the file. Verify no remaining references: grep -r 'agent-orchestration.service' lib/ __tests__/ app/ components/ should return no matches.

phases.name: Verify AgentPanel Placement
phases.description: Verify that AgentPanel is rendered at a consistent, intuitive position in both TaskDetailPanel.tsx (sidebar) and TaskDetailPage.tsx (full page). Based on investigation, placement is already consistent within each view — document the finding.

subtasks.description: Verify AgentPanel placement in both TaskDetailPanel.tsx and TaskDetailPage.tsx. Investigation shows: Panel view places AgentPanel after PRs/Branches (sidebar has no description/spec sections). Page view places AgentPanel after Spec and Sub-tasks (before timeline). Both consistently place it as the last content section. If no changes are needed, document the finding. If positioning should be adjusted for consistency, make the change.

subtasks.notes: Verified: placement is consistent. TaskDetailPanel (sidebar): AgentPanel after PRs/Branches (line 323-332). TaskDetailPage (full page): AgentPanel after Sub-tasks, before Timeline (line 320-330). Both place it as the last content section before non-content elements. No code changes needed.

phases.name: Integration Verification & Cleanup
phases.description: Run TypeScript compilation, existing tests, and verify no regressions. Ensure no circular imports and all agent API routes still resolve.

subtasks.description: Run TypeScript type checking for the main Next.js app to verify no type errors after all refactoring changes.
Run TypeScript type checking for the agent-server to verify no type errors after shared type imports.
Run existing Jest tests to verify no regressions. The context-builder test was updated in phase 4 and should pass with the new import path.
Final verification: confirm no console.log statements remain in lib/agent/, no references to agent-orchestration.service remain outside docs/, and no token/secret values in any log statements.

verification.command: echo '=== console.log check ===' && (grep -rn 'console.log' lib/agent/ 2>/dev/null && exit 1 || echo 'PASS: no console.log in lib/agent/') && echo '=== barrel reference check ===' && (grep -rn 'agent-orchestration.service' lib/ __tests__/ app/ components/ 2>/dev/null && exit 1 || echo 'PASS: no barrel references') && echo '=== token logging check ===' && (grep -rn 'console.*token.*=\|console.*secret.*=\|console.*key.*=' lib/agent/ 2>/dev/null && exit 1 || echo 'PASS: no credential logging')

parallel_groups.reason: All three have no dependencies and modify completely different file sets

parallelism.speedup_estimate: 1.3x faster than sequential — phases 1, 2, 5 can run in parallel, but 3 and 4 are sequential

acceptance_criteria: No console.log statements in lib/agent/ (only console.error for genuine errors)
No GitHub token or credentials appear in any log output
No TypeScript errors in main app (npx tsc --noEmit)
No TypeScript errors in agent-server (cd agent-server && npx tsc --noEmit)
AgentResult, ExecuteAgentOptions, ChangedFile are defined in shared/src/index.ts
Both lib/agent/execute.ts and agent-server/src/agent/execute.ts import from @lumo/shared
No circular imports between lib/agent/ and lib/services/
AgentPanel renders consistently in both task detail views
verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk refactor touching critical agent execution path. All import paths must be validated. Token leak fix is security-critical. TypeScript compilation and existing tests provide comprehensive validation.

integration_tests.notes: Integration tests require running services and API keys. Refactor correctness is validated via TypeScript compilation and unit tests.

checks: AgentPanel appears in consistent position for agent-assigned tasks

browser_verification.notes: No functional UI changes — only verifying existing placement consistency
